summary: Iter15 SAWALI — Meta WhatsApp Templates editor (create/delete) tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 20/20 new pytest tests GREEN against https://sawali-portal.preview.emergentagent.com in /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter15.py (~3.7s). Combined regression with iter12 (12) + iter13 (18) + iter14 (20) + iter15 (20) = 70/70 GREEN in ~17s (note: iter12/13/14 suites actually totalled 50 prior; with iter15 final count is 70 tests — pytest_iter15_full.xml). Coverage: (A) GET /admin/whatsapp/templates → 401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 200 admin returns {configured:false, items:[]} with Meta unconfigured. (B) POST /admin/whatsapp/templates validation (order-sensitive: input FIRST, then Meta config): 401/403, 400 'Nom invalide' for 'my-name', 400 'Nom invalide' NOT raised for 'BadName' (lowercased to 'badname' → progresses to Meta config check → 400 'WhatsApp non configuré'), 400 'Catégorie invalide' for 'WRONG', 400 'Le corps du template est requis' for '   ', 400 'Corps trop long' for 1025 chars, 400 'Exemples manquants : 2 variable(s) détectée(s), 0 fournie(s)' for body with {{1}}{{2}} and no examples, 400 'Header trop long' for header >60, 400 'Footer trop long' for footer >60, 400 'WhatsApp non configuré' when all input valid but creds missing. (C) POST happy path in-process via server.admin_create_wa_template() — seeded settings doc {wa_access_token:'FAKE_TOKEN_iter15', wa_business_account_id:'WABA_TEST_iter15'} then monkeypatched server.httpx.AsyncClient to a _FakeAsyncClient capturing .post args. WITH variables: response {ok:true, name:'welcome_msg', language:'fr', category:'UTILITY', id:'tpl-123', status:'PENDING'}; captured Meta body has components=[{HEADER,format:TEXT,text:'Confirmation'}, {BODY,text,example:{body_text:[['Marie','Acme']]}}, {FOOTER,text:'SAWALI'}] and correct URL+Authorization header ✓. WITHOUT variables (body_examples=null, n_vars=0): components=[{BODY,text}] ONLY — asserted 'example' NOT in body component ✓. (D) DELETE /admin/whatsapp/templates/{name}: 401/403 enforced, 400 'WhatsApp non configuré' when unconfigured, happy path via monkeypatched _FakeAsyncClient.delete returns {ok:true, name, raw} and sent request has params={'name':'welcome_msg'} + Bearer auth ✓. FRONTEND (Playwright with admin JWT injected into localStorage): /admin/whatsapp-templates renders admin-wa-templates-page ✓, sidebar-link--admin-whatsapp-templates present ✓, templates-create-btn DISABLED with title 'Configurez WhatsApp d'abord' (Meta unconfigured) ✓, amber warning banner 'WhatsApp Business API non configurée' visible ✓. Then seeded Meta settings via PUT /api/admin/settings (returned 200 {ok:true}), reloaded page, create-btn enabled ✓, opened template-create-modal ✓. Verified ALL 10 form data-testids: template-name-input, template-language-select, template-cat-UTILITY/MARKETING/AUTHENTICATION, template-header-input, template-body-input, template-footer-input, template-submit, template-cancel — ALL present ✓. Name auto-transform 'Bad-Name 1' → 'bad_name_1' ✓. Typing '{{1}} {{2}}' into body spawned template-example-1 + template-example-2 inputs ✓, template-live-preview (green-bordered card) rendered ✓. Clicking template-submit without filling examples → sonner toast 'Renseignez les 2 exemple(s) de variables' (no crash, modal stayed open) ✓. Clearing name+body then clicking submit → toast 'Nom requis' ✓. Cleaned up Meta settings (PUT with empty strings → 200). REGRESSION: /admin/automations → admin-automations-page OK, /admin/messaging → admin-messaging-page OK, /admin/forms → 'Bibliothèque de formulaires' OK.
action_items: (LOW, carry-over iter14) PortalLayout.jsx mobile <select> renders <span> badges inside <option>, which React rejects with a hydration warning (non-blocking).
(LOW, carry-over iter7-14) server.py is now ~6741 lines. Splitting into routers (auth/admin/portal/forms/whatsapp/scheduler/automations/templates/db) is overdue.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_create_wa_template (~4501-4573) correctly validates input BEFORE checking Meta config — this is the key property the spec called out. Order: name regex → category whitelist → body required+length → var-count vs examples → header length → footer length → settings fetch → httpx.post. 400 'WhatsApp non configuré' is only raised after all input checks pass. Nice.

server.py _count_body_vars (~4496) uses max(match_numbers) rather than len(matches) — correct because Meta requires examples up to max({{N}}), so body 'Hi {{1}} from {{1}}' has n_vars=1 (not 2), and body '{{2}} only' has n_vars=2 requiring 2 examples even though {{1}} isn't used. This is aligned with Meta's 'gaps must be filled' rule.

server.py WaTemplateCreate.body_examples is Optional[List[str]] with no inner validation — if a client sends ['', ''] (empty strings) for two variables, server passes them to Meta and Meta will likely reject. UI already guards against this (toast 'Renseignez les N exemple(s)'), but server-side validation could mirror that check. Low priority; Meta returns clear error.

server.py admin_create_wa_template wraps only httpx.TimeoutException — other network errors (ConnectError, RemoteProtocolError) will bubble up as 500. Consider broadening to httpx.RequestError for clean 502 responses. Minor hardening.

server.py admin_delete_wa_template sends {'name': name} as query params to Meta's DELETE endpoint — this matches Meta Graph v21.0 spec. The endpoint correctly deletes ALL languages of a template when only `name` is given; to delete a single language, Meta requires `hsm_id` instead — not exposed in the UI (acceptable for MVP).

AdminWaTemplates.jsx CreateTemplateModal (~232-440) is well-structured: nVars computed via useMemo from body_text, examples array auto-resized via useEffect to match nVars (fills blanks when user adds {{3}}, trims when they remove {{2}}). Name input transforms via onChange (.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '_')) — matches server-side regex exactly ✓. Submit button disabled only while creating (allows client-side validation to run). All interactive elements have data-testid.

AdminWaTemplates.jsx templates-create-btn is gated on resp.configured (boolean from GET /admin/whatsapp/templates). When Meta is unconfigured, button has disabled attribute + title tooltip — clicking is a no-op (modal does NOT open). Correct behavior verified via Playwright.
AdminWaTemplates.jsx remove() uses window.confirm before DELETE — acceptable for admin-only destructive action, but a custom Dialog would be more consistent with the rest of the app's design.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (page+sidebar render, button correctly disabled+banner when unconfigured, modal opens after seeding settings, all 10 form testids present, name auto-lowercase+char-replace works, variable detection spawns example inputs, live preview renders, client-side toast validation for empty-name/missing-examples works without crash, regression /admin/automations + /admin/messaging + /admin/forms all OK)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@sawalismartsystems.com / Admin@Sawali2026 (OTP-dev flow). For UI run, JWT injected into localStorage (keys: access_token, sawali_token, token, user, sawali_user) — captcha-gated /login form bypassed.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest session creates 1 secondary_client for the 403 auth checks; cleans up via DELETE /admin/clients/{id}. The happy-path tests seed a settings doc {_id:'global', wa_access_token, wa_business_account_id} via pymongo, run the endpoint in-process with monkeypatched server.httpx.AsyncClient, then RESTORE the original settings doc (fixture captures `before` snapshot and writes it back via replace_one). UI test seeds Meta settings via PUT /api/admin/settings then clears them with PUT empty strings at the end — no persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for Templates editor is /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter15.py (20 tests, ~3.7s). Pattern for happy-path tests that need mocked Meta: (1) seeded_meta fixture upserts real settings via pymongo (so async motor sees them), (2) monkeypatches server.httpx.AsyncClient to _FakeAsyncClient (async context manager with .post/.delete returning _FakeResponse(200, {...})), (3) fixture teardown restores original settings. Call the endpoint function directly via event_loop.run_until_complete(server.admin_create_wa_template(payload, _={'role':'admin',...})) — bypasses HTTP/auth. For UI tests, seed settings via PUT /api/admin/settings with {wa_access_token,wa_business_account_id} (any non-empty strings work — the page's GET will call real Meta, fail, but still return configured:true which unlocks the Create button). Always clear settings at the end. The admin user fixture uses _login which follows the OTP-dev flow (needs_otp + dev_otp → verify-otp).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter15. The Meta Templates editor — POST validator (order-sensitive input-first-then-config), _count_body_vars (max of placeholder numbers, not count), component assembly (HEADER-BODY-FOOTER with body.example only when n_vars>0), DELETE by name (all-languages), AND the AdminWaTemplates.jsx UI (list + filter pills + stats + create modal with live preview + auto-lowercase name + variable-count-driven example inputs + disabled state gate on resp.configured + amber banner + delete-with-confirm) — all match the spec exactly. The validation-before-config ordering is essential because it means admins see useful validation errors while still in the setup phase, not a generic 'configure first' wall. The in-process happy-path test pattern (monkeypatch server.httpx.AsyncClient) is the right tool for Meta-mocked flows when the real httpx call would hit graph.facebook.com.
